title: Not sure why these get holes
text: Not sure why these get holes. This plastic seems a bit light as my sealer is putting holes in it. I have owned my sealer for over a year, and it has never caused a hole while sealing any other brand of bags. There is no "setting" for seal, so this has to be the bags themselves. The plastic is not durable enough. I won't buy again.
